question: What should I wear to class?
answer: Wear comfortable, form-fitting clothing that allows you to move freely. Avoid loose or baggy clothes as they can interfere with the equipment and make it harder for instructors to see your alignment. Grip socks are required for all classes and are available for purchase at the studio.

question: Do I need prior Pilates experience?
answer: Not at all! We welcome students of all levels, from complete beginners to advanced practitioners. New to the reformer? Try Alva Foundation for a full-body workout with modifications for every level, or ask us for the best class to start with.

question: How early should I arrive for class?
answer: Please arrive 10-15 minutes before your first class to complete paperwork and get oriented to the studio. For subsequent visits, arriving 5-10 minutes early is sufficient to set up your reformer and settle in.

question: Cancellation Policy
answer:
Our classes are intentionally small to provide a premium, personalized experience. To ensure fairness for all clients, please review our cancellation policy:

Definitions

Cancel at least 12 hours before class: No charge.
Late Cancel: Cancellation within 12 hours of class start.
No-Show: Failing to attend without cancelling.

Fees

Late Cancel: $15
No-Show: $25

Class Packages

Late Cancel: $15 fee; your class credit is returned.
No-Show: Class credit is forfeited.

Unlimited Memberships

Late Cancel: $15 fee.
No-Show: $25 fee.

Waitlist
If you're automatically added to a class from the waitlist, the standard cancellation policy applies.

Late Arrival
For the safety of all clients and to minimize disruption, clients arriving 10 minutes or more after class begins may not be admitted and may be marked as a No-Show.

By booking a class, you acknowledge and agree to this cancellation policy.

question: Privacy Policy
answer:
At Alva Pilates, your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, protect, and share your information when you visit our website, create an account, purchase services, or book classes through our scheduling platform (Mindbody).

1. Information We Collect
We may collect the following:

• Full name, email, phone number, optional address
• Emergency contact information
• Login and account details
• Booking and attendance history
• Membership details and purchase history
• Payment method and billing information (processed securely)
• Health/injury notes voluntarily shared
• IP address, browser type, device information
• Cookies and analytics data

2. How We Use Your Information
We use your information to:

• Manage reservations and membership activity
• Process secure payments
• Send confirmations, updates, and reminders
• Improve website performance and class scheduling
• Enhance client experience
• Maintain health and safety records
• Comply with legal obligations

We do not use your information for any undisclosed purpose.

3. Data Storage & Security
We use industry-standard security practices including:

• Encrypted payment processing
• SSL/HTTPS protection
• Limited internal data access
• Secure third-party hosting partners

Data is retained only as long as necessary for operational, legal, and safety requirements.

4. Third-Party Service Providers
We may share limited information with trusted partners who support studio operations:

• Mindbody (scheduling & client management)
• Secure payment processors
• Email/SMS communication tools
• Website analytics services

These partners do not have permission to sell or misuse your data.

5. Sharing of Information
We share information only when necessary for:

• Service operations
• Legal compliance
• Fraud prevention
• Safety and incident reporting

We do not sell personal information.

6. Cookies & Tracking Technologies
We use cookies to improve the booking and browsing experience. You may disable cookies through your browser settings.

7. Your Rights (CCPA & General Privacy Rights)
California residents may request:

• Access to personal data
• Corrections to inaccurate information
• Deletion of data (when applicable)
• Restriction of certain data uses
• Information about data collection practices

Requests will be answered within 30 days.

8. Children’s Privacy
Alva Pilates does not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13. Any such data will be promptly removed if discovered.

9. External Links
Our website may contain links to external sites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices.

10. Policy Updates
This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically.
Changes take effect immediately upon posting.
Clients will be notified of significant updates.

11. Contact Us
Clients may contact us directly regarding privacy questions or data requests.

question: PURCHASE POLICY
answer:
All purchases at Alva Pilates are final. Class packages, memberships, private sessions, and specialty programs are non-refundable, non-transferable, and intended solely for the purchasing client.

Class packages activate upon first use and expire according to the terms displayed at the time of purchase. Memberships renew automatically unless canceled in accordance with the Membership Agreement.

A valid payment method must be maintained on file for class bookings, membership renewals, and any applicable fees.

Membership Pauses

Approved membership pauses temporarily suspend access to classes but do not change or prorate monthly membership payments. The approved pause period will be added to the end of the membership term so no membership time is lost.

By completing a purchase, you acknowledge and agree to this Purchase Policy.

question: Membership Policy
answer:
Commitment Terms

Membership commitment periods vary by membership tier:

• Essential Membership — 3-month minimum commitment
• Core Membership — Available with a 3-month, 6-month, or 12-month commitment
• Elite Membership — Available with a 6-month or 12-month commitment
• Unlimited Membership — Available with a 6-month or 12-month commitment

Your commitment period begins on your membership start date.

Billing

Memberships are billed automatically on a recurring monthly basis using the payment method on file.

Cancellation Policy

A minimum of 14 days' written notice is required to cancel a membership.

Cancellation requests submitted before the end of the selected commitment period will require payment of the remaining balance due under the membership agreement.

Pause Policy

Memberships may be paused for up to 30 days during each commitment period.

A minimum of 14 days' written notice is required to request a membership pause.

Approved pauses temporarily suspend access to classes but do not change or prorate monthly membership payments. The approved pause period will be added to the end of your commitment period so that no membership time is lost.

For instructions on requesting a pause, please refer to "Can I freeze my membership?" in the Memberships section.

Early Termination

Ending your membership before completing your selected commitment period requires payment of the remaining balance due under your membership agreement.

By purchasing a membership, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to these Membership Terms.

question: Can I freeze my membership?
answer:
Yes. Membership pauses (freezes) are available for extended travel, injury, or other circumstances approved by ALVA PILATES in writing.

Approved pauses temporarily suspend access to classes but do not change or prorate monthly membership payments. The approved pause period will be added to the end of your commitment period so that no membership time is lost.

Pause Guidelines

• Submit a minimum of 14 days' written notice to request a membership pause.
• Memberships may be paused for up to 30 days total during your selected commitment period (3, 6, or 12 months).
• All billing, cancellation, early termination, and commitment terms outlined in the Membership Policy continue to apply during the pause.

If you are a Founding Member, your founding membership rate will remain protected throughout your approved pause and for the remainder of your commitment period.

Please contact ALVA PILATES to submit a written pause request.

question: Is Pilates safe during pregnancy?
answer: Pilates can be excellent during pregnancy when practiced with proper modifications. We recommend private sessions for pregnant clients so we can tailor the exercises to your specific needs and trimester. Always consult with your healthcare provider before starting any new exercise program during pregnancy.

question: I have a back injury. Can I still do Pilates?
answer: Pilates is often recommended for back pain and rehabilitation, but it's essential to work with an instructor who understands your specific condition. We recommend starting with private sessions so we can design a program that supports your recovery. Please bring any relevant medical information to your first session.

question: Do you offer corporate or group rates?
answer: Yes! We offer special rates for corporate wellness programs, bridal parties, and private group events. Contact us for more information about bringing Pilates to your team or celebrating a special occasion at our studio.
